align_correct.PREDICTED_SQL: SELECT AVG(mt.tmean) FROM meteo_tmean mt JOIN landcover_upscaled lu ON mt.latitude = lu.latitude AND mt.longitude = lu.longitude JOIN landcover_type lt ON lu.level1_label = lt.level1_label WHERE lt.level1_label = 'Water bodies' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mt.time) = 2020;

vote.Question: Find the annual average mean temperature for the parts of Thessaly Region with lakes in 2020.
vote.PREDICTED_SQL: SELECT AVG(tmean) FROM meteo_tmean WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM time) = '2020';
